options: A rule that says when a viewer interacts with one sheet a certain way, something happens to another sheet (or the same sheet)
A macro that automatically formats every worksheet in a workbook
A setting that controls dashboard file size only
A type of calculated field used only for KPIs
questions.explain: A dashboard action connects an interaction on a source sheet (hover, click, or menu selection) to an effect on a target sheet — filtering, highlighting, navigating, and more.

questions.q: What is the real difference between a filter action and a highlight action?
options: A filter action narrows the data a target sheet shows; a highlight action colors matching marks and dims the rest without removing any data
A filter action can only run on Hover, while a highlight action can only run on Select
There is no difference — they are the same feature with two names
Highlight actions require a parameter; filter actions never do
questions.explain: Filter actions actually remove non-matching data from the target sheet. Highlight actions leave all the data visible but dim everything except what matches, directing attention without narrowing the view.

questions.q: What does the Show Highlighter option (turned on from a field's right-click menu) do?
options: Adds a search box above that view letting a viewer type to highlight matching marks, without any Actions-dialog configuration
Automatically creates a filter action targeting every other sheet in the workbook
Deletes the field from the view entirely
Publishes the dashboard to Tableau Server
questions.explain: Show Highlighter is the fast, action-free path to highlighting — it only affects the view it's turned on for, unlike a full highlight action which can target a different sheet.

questions.q: Why does this lesson warn against using a Hover trigger for a filter action on a dense scatter plot?
options: Every stray mouse movement would re-filter the whole dashboard, which reads as broken rather than interactive
Hover triggers are not supported for filter actions in any version of Tableau
Hover triggers only work on maps, never on scatter plots
Hover triggers require a parameter to be defined first
questions.explain: Hover fires the instant the pointer rests on a mark. For filter actions, which remove data, that makes stray mouse movements feel like the dashboard is breaking — Select is the safer, more deliberate trigger for filtering.

questions.q: Where do you configure a dashboard action like a filter or highlight action?
options: Dashboard > Actions, which opens the Actions dialog
Format > Fonts
Data > New Data Source
Worksheet > Export
questions.explain: All dashboard actions — filter, highlight, URL, go to sheet, change parameter, change set values — are configured from the same Actions dialog, opened via Dashboard > Actions.
